entities.description: A male soldier with a dark beard and mustache stands facing forward, wearing a green camouflage uniform and a helmet equipped with a mounted night vision device. He holds a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his chest with both gloved hands, wearing a tactical vest and combat boots while standing on a rocky riverbank.

clothing.helmet: green combat helmet with NVG mount

equipment.accessories: holstered sidearm on right thigh, knee pads

attributes.pose: standing, holding rifle with both hands

entities.description: A man with a thick black beard and a black turban stands facing forward, wearing a dark brown double-breasted suit jacket over a light grey button-down shirt and matching dark trousers. He holds a wooden-stocked sniper rifle with a large scope vertically in his right hand, standing on a rocky riverbank with a blurred body of water and hills in the background.

accessories.weapon: sniper rifle with wooden stock and scope

entities.description: A man with a dark beard and a beige turban stands facing forward, wearing a short-sleeved khaki uniform shirt with epaulets and a name tag, paired with matching khaki trousers and a brown leather belt with a gold buckle. He wears brown leather shoes and a wristwatch on his left wrist, with a coiled cord hanging from his left shoulder against a backdrop of a rocky riverbank and hills.

clothing.shirt: khaki short-sleeved uniform with epaulets and name tag
